sourceEvidence.fact: Thin clients connect to the client socket, send Hello, require Welcome, and restore terminal state on normal or error exit.
`terminal session observe` uses connect_terminal_session_stream, performs the real client handshake with ClientLaunchMode::TerminalAttach, then emits JSON terminal.frame envelopes.
The server emits ClientConnected only after a compatible Hello is accepted and Welcome is sent.
`terminal session observe` is a CLI subcommand and therefore bypasses the no-subcommand auto-detect attach path.
Bare `herdr` may spawn a detached server daemon if the client socket is absent, so full-app bare attach is not approved by this gate.
`pane list` returns PaneList with pane records.
PaneInfo exposes both pane_id and terminal_id; terminal_id is the observer target.
The read-only terminal observer prints terminal.frame JSON and returns cleanly on ServerShutdown or EOF.

allowedActions: validate the exact same-device server lifecycle PASS prerequisite
re-download and re-verify the exact pinned v0.8.0 ARM64 asset in a private temporary sandbox
start only explicit foreground `herdr server` with isolated HOME/XDG/TMPDIR and HERDR_SOCKET_PATH
use read-only `herdr pane list` to select an existing terminal_id
run only `herdr terminal session observe <terminal_id> --cols 80 --rows 24` as the client attach
accept only one bounded terminal.frame JSON envelope as transport proof
stop the foreground server with `herdr server stop`, require the observer and server to exit, and verify not_running
write sanitized local untracked evidence and remove the sandbox
forbiddenActions: spawn or leave a detached Herdr daemon
persist or install the Herdr binary
create, close, rename, focus, split or mutate a workspace, tab or pane
send input, keys, prompts or terminal control messages
use terminal session control or takeover
claim full TUI attachment from observer transport proof
test detach/reattach, persistence, agent-state detection or Android background survival
mutate Android device_config, phantom-process limits or battery policy
probe.successGate: validated prior server PASS plus exact binary verification, foreground server readiness, non-mutating pane discovery, one valid terminal.frame from the read-only observer over the client transport, clean observer/server shutdown, and not_running post-state
probe.failureGate: any prerequisite, binary, discovery, handshake, frame, stop, exit or cleanup failure keeps tmux canonical and records sanitized evidence

proofCeiling: This snapshot authorizes one read-only terminal observer client handshake/frame experiment against a freshly started foreground server. A PASS proves client-socket Hello/Welcome compatibility plus one observed terminal frame only. It does not prove bare/full-app TUI attach, detach/reattach, persistence, agent detection, Android background survival, coding-agent work, installation, or tmux retirement.
